objectives.description: Business dictation passage: taking shorthand notes at 80 words per minute from business-related material such as letters, memoranda, reports and related topics.
Transcription of business passage on a typewriter within the allotted time, using correct English and shorthand dictionaries; attaching shorthand notes to the transcript.
Literary dictation passage: taking shorthand notes at 80 words per minute from literary passages within the experience of candidates (non-technical and non-controversial material).
Transcription of literary passage on a typewriter within the allotted time, maintaining speed and accuracy (syllabic intensity 1.35–1.40).
